newsitem.title: USA: Sharon Energy sets extraordinary meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sharon Energy sets extraordinary meeting.

text.p: Sharon Energy Ltd will hold an extraordinary general meeting on May 8 for shareholders to consider ratification of an incentive share option plan and an increase in the company's authorized capital, it said.

The company said in a statement on Tuesday it would seek approval to increase its authorized capital to 100 million common shares and 25 million preferred shares from 10 million common shares and 2.5 million preferred shares.

Under the incentive plan, the board may from time to time grant options to purchase common shares to directors, officers, and employees and consultants of the company and its controlled and subsidiary companies.
Options may be granted on up to 1,172,760 authorized but unissued common shares.
The company expects to require additional financing to complete future exploration on its properties and that such financing may involve the issuance of additional shares.
